When a call came in warning Derek about his uncle passing away, and about a very generous inheritance which included not only an apartment in his hometown, or extremely abundant bank accounts, but a restaurant, Derek didn't see how he could refuse. Once again, Derek Hale was about to uproot his entire life, but this time, instead of fleeing Beacon Hills, he was going back. **** Stiles Stilinski was sick of his life - sick of his shitty job, and his stupid coworkers, and sick of his stupid anxiety.
